name: Pokémon Recordkeepers
storyline: You play as Tiana, a new Recordkeeper who has been tasked with figuring out the mysteries and surrounding various myths and folktales. As you decipher the truth, you will face numerous challenges on your way to each story's conclusion. Overcoming these obstacles grants you new abilities and moves to equip on your Pokemon. Build combinations of abilities and moves never seen before in order to prevail, or fail and try again.
summary: Pokémon Recordkeepers is an experimental rom hack of Pokémon Emerald developed by Turtleye & Hedara featuring a new asymmetrical battle system and battle mechanics in a roguelite experience.
